why: Pharmacy chains are common in Egypt. They need multi-branch support, centralised buying and the same FEFO/expiry/controlled-drug logic as a single pharmacy but across many locations. The owner owns several businesses on one bill.
operator: The pharmacy chain owner manages multiple branch pharmacies under one account. Their day is branch stock visibility, centralised purchasing and ensuring each branch FEFO compliance and controlled-drug log.
entities: Chain (id, nameAr, nameEn, ownerId, taxRegistration, currency, openingHours, branchesCount, isActive)
Branch (id, chainId, nameAr, nameEn, address, phone, currency, taxRegistration, openingHours, fe4oEnabled, controlledDrugEnabled)
PharmacyProduct (id, branchId, sku, nameAr, nameEn, activeIngredient, pricePiasters, costPiasters, taxRate, fe4oFlag, expiryDate, supplierId, status, locationShelf)
Supplier (id, chainId, name, phone, paymentTerms, visitDays, leadTimeDays, isPreferred)
PurchaseOrder (id, branchId, supplierId, status, lines, expectedAt, totalPiasters)
ControlledDrugLog (id, branchId, drugName, batchId, quantityPiasters, dateIn, dateOut, authorisedBy, reason, status (administered/sold/wasted))
Employee (id, branchId, name, phone, role, hourlyRatePiasters, status)
ChainAuditLog (id, chainId, action, performedBy, performedAt, notes)
batches: Yes for all drugs and food: batches with supplier, received date, expiry date and cost, so each branch can sell by batch and claim credit
expiry: Each branch sees alerts for items expiring in 30/60/90 days; central view shows aggregate expiry across all branches
special: The core structures are the chain with branches, the per-branch pharmacy product with FEFO and the centralised controlled-drug log per branch. Multi-branch support with shared central buying is the key differentiator from a single pharmacy.
screens: Chain overview: all branches, branch stock summary, central buying dashboard, expiry aggregate view
Branch selector: switch between branches, view branch-specific data (products, controlled log, staff)
Product catalogue per branch: grid of pharmacy products with name, active ingredient, price, FEFO badge, expiry date badge, stock qty
FEFO food radar per branch: items expiring in 30/60/90 days, value at risk, one-tap discount tag
Controlled drug log per branch: append-only list of administered/sold/wasted drugs with date, batch, quantity, authorised user
Supplier management: list of suppliers per chain, preferred flag, lead time, contact
Purchase order: create per branch, receive from supplier, update branch stock
Cash register per branch: scan SKU or product, apply FEFO discount if urgent, tender payment, print receipt with branch name
roles: Owner: everything : chain, branches, products, controlled logs, reports, billing across all branches
Branch manager: manage branch products, controlled log, staff, purchase orders, view chain overview
Pharmacist: per branch - manage products, controlled drug log, approve administration,
Cashier: per branch - scan products, tender payment, print receipt
reports: Chain-wide expiry aggregate: items expiring in 30/60/90 days across all branches, total value at risk
Branch product sales: which products sell most per branch, revenue per branch per period
Controlled drug log per branch: administered vs sold vs wasted counts per period, audit trail per branch
Centralised buying: purchase orders created, received, total spend per period, preferred supplier performance
FEFO food radar aggregate: total items expiring across all branches, discounts applied across chain
integrations: Esc/POS thermal printer per branch for receipts and controlled log records
WhatsApp deep link per branch for stock alerts and supplier contact
Email for purchase order updates and supplier contracts (opt-in)
Centralised dashboard: Firebase for chain-wide data, branch-level IndexedDB for local ops
onboarding: Chain basics: name, owner, tax registration, currency, opening hours, initial branch count
Initial branch: the first branch address, phone, currency, opening hours, FEFO and controlled drug enabled flag
Initial product list: the starting pharmacy product list per branch with SKU, active ingredient, price and FEFO flag
Supplier list: the first preferred supplier with terms and lead time
First week plan: create first branch, first product, first purchase order
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the chain/branch/pharmacy product/schema and role templates.

tasks.title: Add chain overview with branch switching
tasks.brief: Build the chain screen: all branches, branch stock summary, central buying dashboard, expiry aggregate view. Done when the chain overview loads and branch switching works correctly.
tasks.done: When chain overview works and branch switching displays correct per-branch data

tasks.title: Add branch-specific product catalogue with FEFO
tasks.brief: Build the product catalogue per branch: grid of products with name, active ingredient, price, FEFO badge, expiry date badge, stock qty. Done when the catalogue loads and displays products with FEFO badges correctly per branch.
tasks.done: When product catalogue per branch displays live data with FEFO badges

tasks.title: Add FEFO food radar per branch
tasks.brief: Build the FEFO radar screen per branch: items expiring in 30/60/90 days, value at risk, one-tap discount tag. Done when the radar pulls branch-specific live data and the discount tag works.
tasks.done: When FEFO radar per branch works end-to-end with discount tag

tasks.title: Add controlled drug log per branch
tasks.brief: Build the controlled drug log per branch: append-only list of administered/sold/wasted drugs with date, batch, quantity, authorised user. Done when the log saves each entry as append-only and the audit trail is persistent per branch.
tasks.done: When controlled drug log per branch works end-to-end with append-only audit

tasks.title: Add supplier management per chain
tasks.brief: Build the supplier screen: list of suppliers per chain, preferred flag, lead time, contact. Done when the supplier is saved and appears in the purchase order screen.
tasks.done: When supplier management works and suppliers appear in purchase orders

tasks.title: Add purchase order per branch
tasks.brief: Build the purchase order screen: create per branch, receive from supplier, update branch stock. Done when the order saves and branch stock increments correctly.
tasks.done: When purchase order per branch works end-to-end with stock update

tasks.title: Add cash register per branch with FEFO discount
tasks.brief: Build the cash register per branch: scan SKU or product, apply FEFO discount if urgent, tender payment, print receipt with branch name. Done when the sale records correctly and receipt prints with branch name.
tasks.done: When cash register per branch works end-to-end with FEFO discount and receipt prints

tasks.title: Add chain-wide expiry aggregate report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing items expiring in 30/60/90 days across all branches and total value at risk. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When chain-wide expiry aggregate report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add branch product sales report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing which products sell most per branch and revenue per branch per period. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When branch product sales report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add controlled drug log per branch audit report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing administered vs sold vs wasted counts per period per branch with audit trail. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures and the append-only nature is verifiable per branch.
tasks.done: When controlled drug log audit report computes correctly from live data per branch and shows append-only

risks: Encryption key loss makes chain and branch records unrecoverable across all branches
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
FEFO expiry without proper batch tracking can safety-compromise patients across branches
Centralised buying without clear audit per branch can violate legal requirements on per-branch reporting
